description.embed_passage: פוליסת אחריות מקצועית מספקת כיסוי לאירועים שהתרחשו לפני תאריך האפקטיבי של מיזוג, איחוד או רכישה. במקרה של שינוי מבני בעסק המבוטח, הכיסוי יחול רק על אירועים שהתרחשו קודם לכן. אין כיסוי לעסק השני אלא אם המבטח הסכים מראש.
notable_values: Merger/Amalgamation/Take-over: Coverage applies to events prior to effective date
Other Concern Coverage: Requires insurer agreement in writing
No coverage: to the other concern without prior insurer agreement

sketch:
5. Merger, Amalgamation, Take-over
If the business of the assured shall be merged and amalgamated with some other concern or  if  the  business  of  some  other  concern  shall  be  consolidated  with  the  business  of  the Assured or if the business of the Assured shall become a party to a take-over, then the cover provided under this policy is amended to apply only to an event committed prior to the effective date of the said merger, amalgamation or take over. There shall be no cover whatsoever to the other concern or business as mentioned above unless the insurer has agreed in writing prior to the said effective date and subject to any terms and conditions as agreed by the insurer.

טבלה: פוליסת אחריות מקצועית
This table outlines conditions related to mergers, amalgamations, and take-overs for a professional liability insurance policy. It details how coverage is affected when the insured business undergoes a structural change.
ממדים: Scenario: Merger, Amalgamation, or Take-over, Policy Coverage Conditions

5. Merger, Amalgamation, Take-over
If the business of the assured shall be merged and amalgamated with some other concern or  if  the  business  of  some  other  concern  shall  be  consolidated  with  the  business  of  the Assured or if the business of the Assured shall become a party to a take-over, then the cover provided under this policy is amended to apply only to an event committed prior to the effective date of the said merger, amalgamation or take over. There shall be no cover whatsoever to the other concern or business as mentioned above unless the insurer has agreed in writing prior to the said effective date and subject to any terms and conditions as agreed by the insurer.
